### Annual Report 2025

B. Braun continued its long-term growth path in fiscal year 2025. Group sales increase by 5.1
percent at constant currencies to € 9.4 billion.

][159]
[
[nurse talking with patient at the bedsite]

### More time for patient care.

Global staff shortages make health care professionals the most valuable resource in hospitals. Their
most limited asset is time. Discover solutions to help free up precious time.

][160]
[
[A healthcare professional is shown standing proudly with a sustainable-produced medical container.]

### New standards in sterile processing and operating room supply

A reliable and efficient supply of the OR is essential for creating daily and long-term success in
hospital processes. Digitally enhanced solutions to achieve clinical excellence.

][161]
[
[A medical laboratory employee is pouring liquid for a quality check.]

### Sustainability from the depths

With the expansion of its disinfectant production facility in Sempach, Switzerland, B. Braun is now
seizing the opportunity to set new standards in energy management.

][162]
[
[Digital microscope for neurosurgery named Aesculap Aeos® in front of a white background]

### A precise view of the future: New digital microscope technology for neurosurgery

New technology allows high-resolution views into the human body, making it a prerequisite for more
precise surgery.

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]
[Four medical Professionals walking down a hallway]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

[ Learn More About Y-Knotless™ Flex ][171]

# Exceptional People,
# Exceptional Outcomes

## A Medical Device Company Driven by a Shared Mission

As a global medical equipment manufacturer, we embrace a people-first culture that starts with a
mission to support our healthcare partners and the patients they serve. We design, build, and
distribute clinical products and surgical technologies for Orthopedic and General surgical
specialties, as well as patient monitoring needs, to medical institutions around the world —
enabling optimal patient outcomes.

[ Start a Conversation ][166]

### A Boldly Innovative Insufflation Solution

AirSeal^{®} is the only insufflator backed by clinical data* - positively affecting your patients'
intra and postoperative outcomes.

[ Learn More About AirSeal^{®} ][167]
[ Review the Data ][168]

### BioBrace^{®} Reinforced Bioinductive Implant

### The future of healing

The BioBrace^{®} implant combines the biological healing potential of highly porous Type I collagen
with the mechanical strength of PLLA microfilaments to support tendon healing. Engineered to protect
repairs during the vulnerable healing phase, the BioBrace^{®} implant promotes tissue growth,
reduces stress on healing tissue, and supports the body's natural healing processes.

[ Learn More About BioBrace^{®} ][169]
[ See the Data ][170]

### Y-Knotless™ Flex All-Suture Knotless Anchor: Shuttle with Ease. Fixate with Confidence.

The next generation of knotless technology is here with Y-Knotless™ Flex. Engineered for effortless
shuttling and designed to provide color-coded clarity during each step of the procedure.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

and the word PHARMACY visible in the background.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at
a computer.]

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

meet broad and complex clinical needs and to help healthcare professionals reduce the human and
economic consequences of wounds.

Acute, chronic and surgical wound indications, covering key considerations and common aetiologies
(such as inflammation, trauma or vascular deficiency) to help you build a treatment or prevention
plan to restore tissue integrity, reduce complications and promote healing.

A range of wound care products for targeted intervention on acute, chronic and surgical wounds based
on your patient’s needs and clinical strategy. Solutions range from core products for exudate
management and compression, through to advanced therapies for non-healing wounds and prevention of
infection via antimicrobial barriers.

[ View all ][89]

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

Frequently Asked Questions

## Answers for International Patients

Our international patient advisors are here to help you, 24/7.

**Still have questions?** [Talk to an Advisor][77]
01What exactly does Acıbadem Health Point do for me?

We are your single point of contact for treatment in Türkiye — reviewing your case with the right
specialists, building a clear plan and estimate, and coordinating every detail from your first
question to your recovery back home.

02How do I start, and what does it cost to ask?

Share your reports or simply describe your situation. A specialist reviews your case and you receive
a tailored plan with transparent cost information. The initial assessment costs you nothing.

03Can I speak to a doctor before deciding to travel?

Yes. You can request a written second opinion or a secure video consultation with an Acıbadem
specialist, so you decide with full confidence before booking anything.

04Will I be understood in my own language?

A dedicated multilingual team and professional interpreters support you before, during and after
treatment, so nothing is lost between you and your doctors.

05Are the hospitals and doctors truly world-class?

Care is delivered in JCI-accredited hospitals by physicians recognised internationally in their
fields, using the same advanced technology and protocols you would expect from a leading global
centre.

06What happens after I return home?

Your treatment does not end at discharge. You leave with full medical documentation and a direct
line back to your care team for follow-up questions and ongoing guidance.

# Vehicle diagnostics.

Built on 35 years’ experience.

[Get 35% discount on ICON!][61][Get 35% discount on ADAS][62]

## Download diagnostic software

Get the latest software release to perform diagnosis on cars, trucks, buses and light commercial
vehicles.

[To download][63]
[Mechanic talking in phone with Autocom Repair Services]

## Autocom Repair Services

Get personal support from a brand-specific master technician
so you can finish every job in your own workshop.

[Read more][64]
[For CARS and TRUCKS diagnostic software]

### Diagnostic tool

ICON is the only diagnostic tool you need. Vehicle diagnostic solutions for passenger cars, trucks,
trailers and buses.

[Read more][65]
[vehicle diagnostics for cars and trucks]

### Diagnostic Tablet

High performance and great durability to service and repair vehicles.

[Read more][66]
[Access secutiry locked cars with Autocom Secure Gateway]

### Secure Gateway

Access to vehicle manufacturers security locked car models and systems. Easy, legal, fast and
seamless.

[Read more][67]
[The Autocom ACS rig for calibration of Advanced Driver Assistance Systemson cars and LCV]

### ADAS cars calibration

Mobile solution for calibration of the assistance systems on most brands and models in the market.

[Read more][68]

### News

Here you can read our latest news. You can see all published news by clicking the button to the
right.

[See more news][69]
[Release CARS & TRUCKS]

7/2/2026

Release highlights

A new, big update is here.We are happy to announce that both Abarth and Hyundai are now added to
Secure Gateway. 

[Read more][70]
[vehicle diagnostics for cars and trucks]

Get 35% discount on ICON!

5/7/2026

Other

Celebrating 35 years of trusted diagnostics with an amazing anniversary offer on ICON. The
all-in-one tool.

[Read more][71]
[For CARS and TRUCKS diagnostic software]

And 35% discount on ADAS + 3 tablets of your choice free of charge!

5/7/2026

Other

Amazing discounts also on our ADAS solution.
This is a deal you do not want to miss. 

[Read more][72]

**Global distributor network ready to assist you**

We are proud to work with reliable distributors all over the world. They are ready to help you with
any questions or guidance you need about our products. Our official distributors are carefully
selected for their expertise and commitment to quality, ensuring you get the support and information
you deserve.

If you are interested in learning more or purchasing our products, please contact a official
distributor. They can provide you with comprehensive information and help you with any enquiry.


Contact an official distributor today to find out more.

## About us

#### Solutions for human and veterinary medicine

We offer to doctors, hospitals and the industry: Endoscope –**repair** and –**servicing**, no matter
which brand and which model, **manufacture and sale** of endoscopes and associated instruments.
**We have a certified quality management system in accordance with DIN EN ISO 13485**
**Manufacturer in the world center of medical technology: Tuttlingen, Germany**

## We will repair your endoscope regardless of which manufacturer it was made by

Endodoctor is a manufacturer and repair company for endoscopes of all the most well-known brands. As
a result, endoscopes from Endodoctor are compatible with almost all major manufacturers of medical
devices. Endodoctor endoscope services has developed into a successful medical technology company
within a very short time. The service has strong foundations, resulting in constant upward growth
for the company. The great demand for value and sustainability has always been the motivation that
drives us. Since the beginning, we have been maintaining and repairing endoscopes and instruments
from all of the various brands. The repair spectrum extends from video endoscopes to endoscopy
cameras and the optics for most medical devices. We will be pleased to submit a binding offer for
the repair of your endoscopes and instruments.

## Individual service contracts

The prerequisite to providing the customer with optimal health care is the smooth functionality of
the endoscopes and instruments. Together with our customers we develop service concepts tailored to
their needs, which ensures the long-term value of all our medical products. In order to achieve
this, the first step is bringing the medical stock up to optimal condition. The Endodoctor Service
Agreement guarantees that this condition will be sustained over the entire contract period. We help
our customers and partners to separate important matters from the unimportant ones and to gain time
for the essentiales.

## Quality assurance in medical technology

Medical quality assurance is a key issue in medical technology manufacturing and repair. Our
MPG-compliant quality management guarantees that all binding requirements for the compliant
application or market release of medical devices are met. So trust yourself to be in the best of
hands. We will be glad to assist you personally.

## Development and production of medical equipment

Endodoctor offers its customers a comprehensive range of rigid and flexible endoscopes for all the
specialist areas of human and veterinary medicine. We develop, produce and market endoscopes and
endoscopic accessories in over 30 countries worldwide, all of them made in Tuttlingen (Germany). Our
customers are doctors, hospitals and the medical specialist trade. We always focus on compatibility
with existing systems. Economically, this gives our customers many advantages. In addition to
marketing our own products, we are also increasingly active as an OEM (Original Equipment
Manufacturer). Our equipment is marketed and used worldwide under the most diverse brand names. We
carry out the following work for our OEM partners: assembly of customer-specific components, serial
production of existing product lines, as well as development of new equipment.

## About us

#### Solutions for human and veterinary medicine

We offer to doctors, hospitals and the industry: Endoscope –**repair** and –**servicing**, no matter
which brand and which model, **manufacture and sale** of endoscopes and associated instruments.
**We have a certified quality management system in accordance with DIN EN ISO 13485**
**Manufacturer in the world center of medical technology: Tuttlingen, Germany**

## We will repair your endoscope regardless of which manufacturer it was made by

Endodoctor is a manufacturer and repair company for endoscopes of all the most well-known brands. As
a result, endoscopes from Endodoctor are compatible with almost all major manufacturers of medical
devices. Endodoctor endoscope services has developed into a successful medical technology company
within a very short time. The service has strong foundations, resulting in constant upward growth
for the company. The great demand for value and sustainability has always been the motivation that
drives us. Since the beginning, we have been maintaining and repairing endoscopes and instruments
from all of the various brands. The repair spectrum extends from video endoscopes to endoscopy
cameras and the optics for most medical devices. We will be pleased to submit a binding offer for
the repair of your endoscopes and instruments.

## Individual service contracts

The prerequisite to providing the customer with optimal health care is the smooth functionality of
the endoscopes and instruments. Together with our customers we develop service concepts tailored to
their needs, which ensures the long-term value of all our medical products. In order to achieve
this, the first step is bringing the medical stock up to optimal condition. The Endodoctor Service
Agreement guarantees that this condition will be sustained over the entire contract period. We help
our customers and partners to separate important matters from the unimportant ones and to gain time
for the essentiales.

## Quality assurance in medical technology

Medical quality assurance is a key issue in medical technology manufacturing and repair. Our
MPG-compliant quality management guarantees that all binding requirements for the compliant
application or market release of medical devices are met. So trust yourself to be in the best of
hands. We will be glad to assist you personally.

## Development and production of medical equipment

Endodoctor offers its customers a comprehensive range of rigid and flexible endoscopes for all the
specialist areas of human and veterinary medicine. We develop, produce and market endoscopes and
endoscopic accessories in over 30 countries worldwide, all of them made in Tuttlingen (Germany). Our
customers are doctors, hospitals and the medical specialist trade. We always focus on compatibility
with existing systems. Economically, this gives our customers many advantages. In addition to
marketing our own products, we are also increasingly active as an OEM (Original Equipment
Manufacturer). Our equipment is marketed and used worldwide under the most diverse brand names. We
carry out the following work for our OEM partners: assembly of customer-specific components, serial
production of existing product lines, as well as development of new equipment.

# See what your competitors
# will do next.

While others chase press releases and earnings calls, we capture real intelligence from the data
trails companies leave behind unknowingly — whether competitors, acquisition targets, potential
partners, or emerging disruptors.

Book a Demo
[Watch the Walkthrough][7]
[From digital exhaust to predictions]

## Trusted by teams at

[Intuit][S2A][Eleventh Hour Group][Abridge]
The Problem

## Why traditional intelligence falls short
* Curated narrativePress releases, earnings calls, official announcements — that's the story
  companies want you to see. By the time something is announced, it's too late to respond
  strategically. You're reacting, not planning.
* Commoditized sourcesTraditional market intelligence pulls from the same obvious sources everyone
  else uses. If you're reading it, so are your competitors.
* Data without contextTraditional tools bombard you with notifications — a job posting here, a doc
  update there. You spend hours trying to figure out what matters. You have alerts, not answers.

How it works

## From digital exhaust to predictions

Each step compresses the input. Thousands of raw signals collapse into a handful of patterns, then
into a single forecast you can act on.
* Digital exhaust
  LinkedIn activity
  Job descriptions
  API documentation
  Web & copy changes
  Reddit threads
  + 19 more source types

  updates and more. Intelligence they never meant to share.

  Field sales push

  Endpoints + docs added
  SynthesizeA single job post or pricing page tweak is noise. Hundreds, woven together, become
  patterns. We connect signals across sources — hiring spikes, doc changes, ad shifts, partnership
  chatter — to surface the combinations that actually mean something.
  Predictions
  Forecast
  Mid-market
  enterprise launch
  Hiring, product, and brand signals align one direction.
  Within 60 days
  High confidence
  PredictFrom the patterns, we forecast what's coming next — product launches, market entries,
  acquisitions, organizational pivots — each with a time horizon and confidence score. You see the
  move before it's made, not after the press release.

Our mission is to provide general and advanced/interventional gastroenterology services in an
Affable, Affordable & Accessible manner for Accurate Answers.

With over 60 providers and over 25 locations in Pinellas, Hillsborough, Pasco, Polk, and Hernando
counties, Gastro Florida offers G.I. screening & treatment, colon cancer prevention, non-surgical
cancer intervention, IBD infusions & therapy, nutrition & weight loss services, remote monitoring
between visits, pharmacy & pathology services, and the latest therapies, including clinical
research, to provide an **integrated patient experience**.

[[Doctor at Gastro Florida talking to Patient]][40]

### [Find a Physician][41]

Gastro Florida is comprised of skilled, compassionate doctors with decades of combined experience.
Our providers have been trained all over the US; this diversity allows for direct access to multiple
sources of expertise and high-level consultations all in-house.

[][42]

### [Colon Cancer Screening][43]

Without a colonoscopy, you may not know if you are among the 150,000 Americans this year who will
develop colorectal cancer, America’s number #2 cancer killer. Schedule your colon cancer screening
today.

[Woman in a doctors office participating in Clinical Research]

### Clinical Research

Gastro Florida offers clinical research trials in which volunteers participate and receive a trial
treatment for a particular condition while under supervision.

[IBD Experts]

### IBD Experts

At Gastro Florida, we diagnose and treat IBD, Inflammatory Bowel Disease, including Crohn’s disease
and ulcerative colitis, with a team approach that supports your health, lifestyle, and peace of
mind.

## Meet Your Gastroenterologist

Gastro Florida is comprised of skilled, compassionate providers with many decades of combined
experience in gastroenterology. Click on your provider below to learn more about their skills and
expertise.
[
Ali Abbas, M.D.

Dr. Abbas is a Board-Certified Gastroenterologist, Interventional and bariatric endoscopist. Dr.
Abbas is one among handful of fellowship-trained bariatric/advanced endoscopists nationwide who
graduated from Harvard Medical School’s Brigham & Women’s Hospital. He completed his
Gastroenterology fellowship at the University of South Florida after finishing Internal Medicine
residency at the University of Florida-Gainesville. He earned his medical degree from Al-Kindy
College of Medicine and MPH in Epidemiology from Tulane University as a Fulbright Scholar. From
2020-2022, Dr. Abbas was an Assistant Professor of Medicine and Surgery at the University of South
Florida and the Director of Bariatric Endoscopy service. Dr. Abbas introduced several cutting-edge
advanced endoscopy procedures to the USF-TGH system. Additionally, Dr. Abbas had one of the highest
adenoma detection rates (68% and 54% for male and female patients respectively) for screening
colonoscopy in USF-TGH system. He is providing office visits and endoscopies in our new Wesley
Chapel practice and hospital GI consults & procedures at Advent Health Wesley Chapel and the new
BayCare Hospital Wesley Chapel.

## of mdma

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

### Leadership

Saved industry jobs and over $30B with device tax repeal

### Mission

Accelerating patient access and improving health outcomes

### Network

Hundreds of companies of all sizes championing MedTech innovation

“As our organization grows and seeks to continue improving patient care, MDMA has been the perfect
partner to help our team overcome regulatory and reimbursement challenges throughout the years.”

Laura Francis | Chief Executive Officer, SI-BONE

“As a past CEO of multiple companies over the years, MDMA has always been a great resource and
valuable partner in our efforts to improve patient outcomes.”

Doug Godshall | Chairman of the Board of Directors, Saluda Medical & Executive Chairman, Galvanize
Therapeutics

“I have been fortunate to lead both large and small companies, and no matter what policy challenges
they faced, I would always want MDMA to be our voice, advocate and partner. The active engagement
with MDMA and collaboration with fellow members is essential for companies of all sizes to improve
patient care and the innovation ecosystem.”

James (Jim) V. Mazzo | Executive Chairman, Neurotech

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

[ About Mount Bonnell ][28]

Check out our gallery page with beautiful photos of Mount Bonn that other visitors have shared. Why
not share your own favorite pic featuring Mount Bonnell for the chance to win a cool t-shirt?

# Enjoy the Best Views in Austin from Mount Bonnell

#### From Mount Bonnell, the high point Austin TX, you have awesome views on Austin, the Colorado
#### River and the Texas Hill Country

[ Visit Mount Bonnell ][23]
 

### What to Do at Mount Bonnell

At the peak you will find Covert Park, an Austin view point with 360-degree views that include the
city skyline and Lake Austin. This free Austin Mount Bonnell experience attracts locals and tourists
from around the world and offers a variety of activities. There are plenty of nearby Lake Austin
hotels and luxury hotels in Austin to provide you with a memorable stay.

[ 10 Reasons to Visit Austin Mt Bonnell ][24]

## About Mount Bonnell

Bonnell Mountain is a great landmark and one of the most visited sites and tourist attractions in
Austin. The limestone height stands at 775 ft above sea level and is considered to be the highest
point within Austin City Limits. It has been a popular sightseeing destination since the mid-19th
century and continues to attract tourists and locals for mountain biking, hiking, and more on the
Mount Bonnel hiking trail. In fact, it’s a favorite for mountain bikers and a Mount Bonell hike is
on the bucket list of many tourists. Mount Bonnell also known as Covert Park belongs, next to other
parks such as Mueller Lake Park and Zilker Park, to the best parks in Austin.

Visit Mt. Bonnell Austin TX and Covert Park at Mount Bonnell trails and enjoy the beauty of the
Austin skyline. If you want to learn more, you can also buy one of many topographic maps with
elevation data and Austin TX Mount Bonnell directions. So, when tourists arrive and ask: Are there
mountains in Austin, Texas? You can tell them to get ready for an exciting walk on the Mt Bonell
stairs to the top. While you’re visiting Bonnell Austin, don’t forget to take in [Circuit of
Americas][25] Austin TX, the country’s premier destination for phenomenal motorsports and live
entertainment. If you’re a diehard sports fan, check out 104.9 The Horn Austin, it’s a local Austin
radio station with station broadcasts in sports format and is the flagship station of the Texas
Longhorns. If My Bonnell has given you an appetite for heights take a trip out to Texas Hill Country
to see the rural countryside of Central Texas with its rugged hills and native vegetation.

If you’re looking for accommodation, you’ll be spoilt for choice, from family hotels to five star
hotels in Austin. [Hotel Saint Cecilia][26] in Austin and [The Loren at Lady Bird Lake][27] both
offer upscale accommodations where you can recover after sightseeing in two of the best Austin
luxury hotels.

## About Our CEO

Jonathan Azevedo is the Chief Executive Officer and founder of [Outer Reef Technologies][63].  He is
an industry veteran who has worked across many business sectors including defense, commercial and
medical.  Jonathan has a proven track record of success through his systematic understanding and
data driven decision making.  Mr. Azevedo’s technical experience dates back to 2004 when he started
developing self-driving cars.  Jonathan then participated in the DARPA Grand and Urban Challenges,
in order to promote the growth of technology which is now being used in today’s vehicles.  In 2009,
Mr. Azevedo entered the [medical device][64] industry where he helped develop the very first
orthopedic robotic platform.  Jonathan then founded Outer Reef Technologies and Plug and Play
Robotics in 2012 and 2014, respectively.  Jonathan donates much of his personal time to educational
programs and non-profit organizations such as FIRST Robotics, Habitat for Humanity, Guide Dog for
the Blind Foundation, among others.  Jonathan graduated from the University of Florida and holds a
B.S in Mechanical Engineering, and a M.S in Robotics Engineering.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

# Robot Simulation Software

RoboDK is a complete solution to simulate and program robot arms offline for robot manufacturing and
automation.

[ Download Trial ][47]

## Extensive Robot Library

Up-to-date library of robot arms, manufacturing applications and sample industrial automation
projects.

[Library][48]

## CAD/CAM Software

Extensive integration options with CAD/CAM software, making it easier to simulate and program robots
to automate manufacturing.

[Success Stories][49]

## Marketplace

Plenty of Add-ins and extensions at your disposal to enhance and customize RoboDK software.

[Add-in Marketplace][50]

## Easy to Use

RoboDK's intuitive interface requires no programming skills to simulate robot arms and the
step-by-step guide simplifies the process of generating robot programs.

[ Getting Started Guide][51]

## Software Features

RoboDK offers all the features required create your Digital Twin quickly and accurately.

[RoboDK robot]
* [
  
  ### Robot Simulation & Offline Programming
  
  Create robot simulations and robot programs for any robot arm in minutes. You can easily and
  accurately simulate your robot arms with RoboDK software.
  
  ][52]
* [
  
  ### Robot Machining
  
  Use robots for manufacturing applications such as robot machining or 3D printing. Simulate and
  convert 5-axis CNC programs such as G-Code or APT-CLS for your robot controller.
  
  ][53]
* [
  
  ### Robot Programs
  
  Easily generate robot programs offline for any robot controller. You don't need to learn
  vendor-specific programming anymore.
  
  ][54]
* [
  
  ### Support 3D Models
  
  Import 3D models in formats such as STL, STEP, and IGES, and accurately create your Digital Twin.
  
  ][55]
* [
  
  ### Post Processors
  
  RoboDK Post Processors include support for many robot controllers, including ABB RAPID (mod/prg),
  Fanuc (LS/TP), KUKA KRC (SRC), Motoman Inform (JBI), Universal Robots (URP/script) and much more!
  
  ][56]
* [
  
  ### External Axes
  
  Easily integrate and simulate robots with external axes to extend the reachability of your robot.
  
  ][57]
* [
  
  ### Robot Accuracy
  
  Calibrate your robot arm to improve accuracy up to 0.100 mm. RoboDK software combines all the
  simulation and calibration features in one solution.
  
  ][58]
* [
  
  ### Avoid Singularities and Collisions
  
  Easily create your Digital Twin offline and prevent the robot from going through singularities,
  axis limits and collisions.
  
  ][59]
* [
  
  ### RoboDK API
  
  Create robot programs using modern programming languages such as Python, C# or C++. Software
  developers can easily customize the interface.
  
  ][60]

## Supported Robot Brands

RoboDK supports over 80 different robot manufacturers, providing access to an extensive robot
library.

[ Robot Library][61]
[ 15 more ][62]

Use robot arms for any manufacturing application. You can find plenty of examples in our
documentation.

were able to secure the compensation he deserved.

“One check showed up, and then another check showed up, and then another, and they’re still coming
in now,” expressed Jimmy. “I know my wife will be taken care of for the rest of her life after I’m
gone.”

## We Can Help

Our network of attorneys has been helping individuals, like you, for years. Find Yourself a Lawyer
That Will Fight For You and Your Rights!

p

#### Do I Have A Case

If you or a loved one have suffered, you may be entitled to financial compensation.



#### Experienced Attorneys

Our team of experts has extensive experience in product liability, medical devices, personal injury,
and harmful drugs. And are fighting to hold negligent manufacturers and distributors accountable. 

}

#### Act Now

Contact us immediately to set up a free, confidential, and no-obligation case review.  We’re ready
to fight for you.



#### Product Liability



#### Medical Devices



#### Harmful Drugs

# Product Liability

# Social Media Harm

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Social media platforms like Instagram, TikTok, and Snapchat were designed to keep kids scrolling,
and thousands of families are now paying the price. If your child developed an eating disorder,
depression, or self-harm behaviors tied to social media use, you may be entitled to compensation.

[See If you Qualify][1]

# Medical Device

# Olympus Scope

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Olympus duodenoscopes and other endoscopic devices have been associated with design and
sterilization failures that allowed dangerous bacteria, including drug-resistant superbugs, to
spread between patients during medical procedures. If you or a loved one developed a serious
infection following an Olympus scope procedure, you may have legal options.

[See If you Qualify][2]

# Spinal Cord Stimulators

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Spinal Cord Stimulators are implantable devices used to manage chronic pain. Manufacturers,
including Abbott, Boston Scientific, Medtronic, and Nevro, now face lawsuits alleging their devices
caused serious injuries, including electric shocks, lead wire fractures, nerve damage, and worsening
pain. A federal MDL has been established for Boston Scientific SCS cases, centralized in the Central
District of California. Patients injured by these devices may be entitled to compensation.

[See If you Qualify][3]

# Power Port Lawsuit 

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Lawsuits allege that Bard PowerPort devices implanted for chemotherapy and infusion treatment were
defectively designed, leading to serious complications including catheter breakage, migration,
infection, and organ failure. You may qualify if your port was implanted after 2007, you experienced
a qualifying complication within the last five years, and the port has since been removed.

[See If you Qualify][4]

# Harmful Drugs

# Tylenol Lawsuit

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Studies have linked prenatal acetaminophen (Tylenol) use to an increased risk of autism and ADHD in
children. If you took Tylenol or a store-brand acetaminophen during pregnancy and your child has
been diagnosed, you may be entitled to compensation.

[See If you Qualify][5]

# Kratom Lawsuit

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Kratom and 7-hydroxymitragynine (7-OH) products, sold openly at gas stations and smoke shops, have
been linked to addiction, organ damage, overdose, and death. Despite being marketed as safe, natural
supplements, these products are unregulated, carry no FDA approval, and in some cases contain
compounds up to 13 times more potent than morphine. Manufacturers are now facing lawsuits for
failing to warn consumers of the dangers. If you or a loved one suffered serious harm after using
kratom or 7-OH products, you may be entitled to compensation. Case reviews are free, and you pay
nothing unless you win.

[See If you Qualify][6]

# Gabapentin Lawsuit 

#### THIS IS AN ACTIVE LAWSUIT

Gabapentin, commonly prescribed for nerve pain, seizures, and off-label conditions, has been linked
to serious side effects, including dependency, respiratory depression, and increased risk of
overdose, particularly when combined with opioids. If you or a loved one suffered serious harm after
taking gabapentin, you may be entitled to compensation.

[See If you Qualify][7]

### About the Weston A. Price Foundation

**The Weston A. Price Foundation (WAPF) is your source for accurate information on nutrition and
health, always aiming to provide the scientific validation of traditional foodways. People seeking
health today often condemn certain food groups — such as grains, dairy foods, meat, salt, fat,
sauces, sweets and nightshade vegetables — but the Wise Traditions Diet is inclusive, not
exclusive.**

We show you how to include all these nourishing traditional foods in your diet through wise choices
and proper preparation techniques. The result is vibrant health for every age of life, including the
next generation. [Read more. . .][75]
